title: CompiledRule
description: Agent-output: a natural-language automation rule compiled to a deterministic predicate over TradeProposal fields, posted back for one-time human confirmation before risk/ enforces it. LLMs draft rules; they never are the rules (draft-2 /automation). SEC-19: the confirmed_hash pins the exact predicate risk/ enforces; any drift disables the rule. worst_case_notional_per_interval is the deterministically-computed exposure shown at confirm time and hard-capped under a risk/ ceiling; expires_at forces re-confirmation.

rule_id.description: Opaque identifier for this compiled rule.

natural_language.description: The operator's original natural-language rule statement (e.g. 'auto-approve rebalancing trades under $200 in existing positions').

predicate.description: Deterministic predicate over TradeProposal fields that risk/ evaluates. Must not read free-text/thesis/news fields (SEC-19).

worst_case_notional_per_interval.description: Deterministically-computed worst-case exposure ($ per interval) this rule can authorize; hard-capped under a risk/ ceiling.

symbols_scope.description: Uppercase US tickers this rule is scoped to; empty means any allowlisted symbol.

existing_positions_only.description: If true, the rule may only auto-approve trades in currently-held positions.

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant after which the rule is disabled and requires re-confirmation.

confirmed_hash.description: Hex hash of the exact predicate the human confirmed; risk/ enforces only this hash and disables the rule on any drift (SEC-19).
